description: The assigned LexisNexis/all-news workflow was unavailable. Open-web searches used English and Albanian protest, demonstration, strike and issue terms, with week-window, sector, local-event and adjacent-month follow-up, but cannot establish exhaustive national or local coverage. Search result date and crawl metadata were often inconsistent with page/event dates.
required_followup: Coordinator review against the authorized archive and regional/local outlet coverage.

description: The Ballsh wage-arrears campaign was active before October; September reports establish earlier protest activity but not crowd size. October 12 Citizens.al reporting establishes hundreds at a public roadblock, while no earlier 50+ event is demonstrated. A Top Channel result suggests a large crowd but the saved exact percent-encoded request returned HTTP 403 and no body was read; its date and event identity are unverified. Do not infer earlier threshold failure or success from missing counts.
required_followup: Resolve earliest 50+ action and episode ownership with permitted contemporaneous sources; no Top Channel retry without renewed review.

description: The Oct15 mask protest is near the 50-person cutoff: CNA reports approximately 50 while Exit describes tens. October 20 Dendias-related protest attendance is unreported; proceedings against 18 people are not total attendance. The Oct31 health-worker report gives no count and does not establish an explicit government-directed remedy. Their threshold/state-target questions remain open.
required_followup: Seek independent attendance and demand evidence; clarify whether 18 proceedings or station escorts were arrests only if an authoritative report says so.

description: Ballsh Citizens.al Sep14 page S012 remains search-only after the web tool returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable; this is logged as a technical retrieval failure, not a denial. Top Channel S014 returned actual HTTP 403 for the percent-encoded requested URL and remains held; no article body was accessed. Both can affect campaign continuity and event identity.
required_followup: Retain the distinct 503 technical failure and 403 exact-URL hold; do not retry S014 absent renewed manual review.

description: Known AP, HRW, New Arab, Facebook and L’Orient access/origin holds remain unresolved at project level. No affected body or variant was accessed in this unit. Exit attributes the mask demonstration to Facebook mobilization; no Facebook page/post was opened. Search-only or absent records are not treated as permission, and permitted unrelated sources were used instead.
required_followup: Parent/coordinator to maintain exact source/variant scopes; continue using unrelated permitted sources and do not access held origins.

description: The Ballsh campaign is reported ongoing on 21 October (S006). A November search surfaced meeting/settlement leads, but no November body was retrieved in this unit; no closure date is assigned. The public October 12 event is distinguished from the continuing hunger-strike campaign, whose original strikers numbered ten.
required_followup: Check November follow-up and identify when the wage-arrears campaign ended; do not set the month boundary as the event endpoint.

description: The 31 October health-worker item is a paragraph in a CIVICUS country review posted in February 2021; it cites TV Klan but its link/body was not followed. Crowd size, requested remedy, decision-maker and state target remain uncertain.
required_followup: Review the cited TV Klan report only after its exact URL has a fresh access check and manual scope review; seek clear attendance and demand evidence.
